SELECT t.*, d.flow_code, COALESCE(i.business_id, t.business_id) AS businessId, AS business_title, i.flow_name AS instance_flow_name FROM flow_task t LEFT JOIN flow_definition d ON d.id = t.definition_id LEFT JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id AND i.del_flag = '0' WHERE t.del_flag = '0'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM flow_user u WHERE u.associated = t.id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.processed_by IN #{flag} )
AND t.flow_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{flowName}, '%') AND (t.business_id = #{businessId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flow_instance ib WHERE ib.id = t.instance_id AND ib.business_id = #{businessId} AND ib.del_flag = '0')) AND t.node_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nodeName}, '%') AND t.create_time >= #{timeStart} AND t.create_time < concat(#{timeEnd}, ' 23:59:59') ORDER BY t.create_time DESC

SELECT h.*, d.flow_code, COALESCE(i.business_id, h.business_id) AS businessId, AS business_title, i.flow_name AS instance_flow_name FROM flow_his_task h LEFT JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = h.instance_id AND i.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN flow_definition d ON d.id = h.definition_id WHERE h.del_flag = '0' AND (h.approver = #{userId} OR h.collaborator = #{userId}) AND h.flow_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{flowName}, '%') AND (h.business_id = #{businessId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flow_instance ib WHERE ib.id = h.instance_id AND ib.business_id = #{businessId} AND ib.del_flag = '0')) AND h.update_time >= #{timeStart} AND h.update_time < concat(#{timeEnd}, ' 23:59:59') ORDER BY h.update_time DESC

SELECT d.* FROM flow_definition d WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.flow_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{flowCode}, '%') AND d.flow_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{flowName}, '%') AND d.category = #{category} AND d.is_publish = #{isPublish} ORDER BY d.update_time DESC
SELECT i.* FROM flow_instance i WHERE i.del_flag = '0' AND i.business_id = #{businessId} AND i.flow_status IN ('0', '1', '9', '11') ORDER BY i.create_time DESC
SELECT i.* FROM flow_instance i WHERE i.del_flag = '0' AND i.business_id = #{businessId} ORDER BY i.create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM flow_task t WHERE t.del_flag = '0'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM flow_user u WHERE u.associated = t.id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.processed_by IN #{flag} )
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM flow_his_task h WHERE h.del_flag = '0' AND (h.approver = #{userId} OR h.collaborator = #{userId})
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM flow_instance i WHERE i.del_flag = '0' AND i.create_by = #{userId}
SELECT t.* FROM flow_task t WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND t.create_time < ORDER BY t.create_time ASC

SELECT t.id AS taskId, t.definition_id AS definitionId, t.instance_id AS instanceId, t.node_code AS nodeCode, t.node_name AS nodeName, t.create_time AS createTime, n.ext AS nodeExt FROM flow_task t INNER JOIN flow_node n ON n.definition_id = t.definition_id AND n.node_code = t.node_code AND n.del_flag = '0' WHERE t.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY t.create_time ASC
